facts.fact: The Tunisian Monitor reports, citing the Tunis Regional Directorate of Health, that over 9,000 patients were enrolled in the first weeks of the National Health Identifier, a lifetime code meant to connect a patient's medical history across providers, piloted from early July 2026 at Habib Thameur University Hospital using the national identity card.
Health authorities set out a phased plan to extend the NHI to all medical facilities nationwide by the end of 2026.
